name: Dunzo
tagline: Bengaluru hyperlocal 'get anything delivered' app that collapsed despite Reliance backing
facts: Defunct: ops stopped 2024; NCLT insolvency admitted Sep 2025
~$485M raised; Google's first direct India startup bet (2017)
Reliance Retail wrote off ₹1,645 cr in FY25
Biswas, Jha, Suri now run AI and health startups

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Help urban Indians get anything done in their city: pick up, drop and deliver from any local store.

strategy.label: Original model
strategy.text: Task-based 'Dunzo it' concierge: pick-up-drop, medicines, groceries, food; verb-level brand love in Bengaluru.

strategy.label: Pivot
strategy.text: 2021 Dunzo Daily: 19-minute grocery from dark stores, entering quick commerce against Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Reliance's $200M to become JioMart's hyperlocal delivery arm; synergy never materialised and follow-on funding dried up.

strategy.label: Lesson
strategy.text: Hyperlocal needs density and AOV; burning ₹8 per ₹1 revenue in a funding winter with no moat is fatal.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Was Dunzo killed by quick-commerce strategy, by capital timing, or by never owning one high-frequency use case?

customers.pain: No time to run errands across the city
customers.why: One app to send packages, fetch keys, buy medicines, any store
Dunzo Daily dark stores promised 19-minute delivery

customers.pain: No own delivery fleet or online presence
customers.why: Plug-in delivery and discovery without building logistics

customers.pain: Delayed payouts as cash ran out
customers.why: Flexible task-based earnings during peak growth years

customers.who: Reliance, D2C brands needing hyperlocal logistics

rows.how: Distance and surge-based delivery fees per task
Retail margin via marketplace sellers plus brand promotions

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Mostly delivery fees and grocery margins; FY23 operating revenue only ₹227 cr despite national brand.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Consumers loved free or cheap delivery; subsidies meant almost nobody paid true cost.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: FY23 loss ₹1,802 cr: dark-store rent, rider costs and discounts far exceeded low AOV contribution.

bullets.label: Collapse path
bullets.text: 2023 layoffs, salary delays, vendor suits (Google, Meta); co-founders exit; ops halt 2024; insolvency 2025.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: Strategic investors don't guarantee rescue; Reliance chose JioMart in-house and wrote off ₹1,645 cr.

friction: Delivery times slipped as rider supply shrank
Dark-store stockouts after vendor payments stalled
Refunds delayed during the cash crunch
Too many use cases, no clear habit
Shrinking city coverage eroded user trust

competitors.label: Quick commerce
competitors.text: Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket Now, Flipkart Minutes

competitors.label: Pick-up-drop
competitors.text: Swiggy Genie, Porter, Rapido parcel, Uber Connect

competitors.label: Strategic owner
competitors.text: Reliance JioMart built its own quick delivery

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Early first mover; 'Dunzo it' verb-level brand in Bengaluru

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Realised: out-spent by focused, better-funded rivals; ran out of cash

news.label: Apr 2026
news.text: Kabeer Biswas raises $11M from Peak XV, Blume for consumer AI startup.

news.label: Sep 2025
news.text: NCLT Bengaluru admits Dunzo into insolvency on vendor pleas; IRP appointed.

news.label: Aug 2025
news.text: Reliance Retail formally writes off entire ₹1,645 cr Dunzo investment in FY25.

news.label: Watch
news.text: Any asset or brand sale in insolvency; lessons for Zepto and Swiggy Instamart burn.

sources: Inc42, Mint, YourStory, Reliance FY25 annual report coverage, NCLT reports, Wikipedia. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
